title: Pressure calculation sheet
subject: Science
source: Seeded from science/y7 lesson 45 (Pressure calculation sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 45: Pressure. To understand how pressure depends on force and area

model.title: A 600 N box rests on an area of 2 m². Find the pressure.

questions.q: A 500 N pupil stands on 0.04 m² of shoe. Pressure?
questions.model: P = F ÷ A = 500 ÷ 0.04. Dividing by 0.04 is multiplying by 25: 12 500 N/m².

questions.q: Why do camels have wide feet?
questions.a: To spread their weight and not sink into sand

questions.q: Calculate: (a) 200 N on 4 m²; (b) 50 N on 0.5 m²; (c) 1000 N on 0.1 m²; (d) 36 N on 9 cm² (answer in N/cm²).
Why does a sharp knife cut better than a blunt one?
questions.a: Smaller area at the edge, so the same force gives a higher pressure.

questions.q: A 30 N book makes 600 N/m² pressure. What area is it resting on?
Big question: why does a pin go in but not the pencil's flat end?
questions.a: The pin's tiny area makes a much higher pressure for the same force.
